description: Zorro Waterfalls is a scenic natural attraction located in the Maracas Valley area of northern Trinidad, surrounded by the lush tropical vegetation of the Northern Range. The waterfall is reached via a forest trail, making the journey part of the attraction for hikers, nature enthusiasts and adventure visitors. The falls feature fresh mountain water cascading over natural rock formations into a pool below, creating a peaceful setting for relaxation, photography and enjoying Trinidad’s rainforest environment. The surrounding forest supports a variety of tropical plants, birds, insects and other wildlife, adding value for eco-tourism and nature-based experiences. Check current opening arrangements, visitor access and any fees before travelling.
